If the same run hour is re-entered … the orchestrator skips pages that already have a completed progress record rather than re-dispatching them. (vs `scripts/orchestrator_runner.py`)
- `docs/site-src/architecture/lint-rules.md`: Every page the agent authors or edits must carry a required field set defined by the `AGENT_AUTHORED_REQUIRED` contract in `scripts/lint/lint_runner.py`. (vs `scripts/lint/lint_runner.py`)
